notes.title: Minor feature
notes.content: Added log chests, accessible via pressing 'Tab' in the construction menu

notes.title: Minor feature
notes.content: Added a reminder to the corner of the screen of current task, turn on/off with 'O' key

notes.title: Minor bugfixes
notes.content:
Added missing sounds for planter harvesting
Added planter destruction

notes.title: Minor bugfixing
notes.content: Fixed a minor UI related bug with build menu and tab switching

notes.title: Minor feature: Automatic Planters
notes.content:
Added planters that automatically grow plants up to a full item stack
The planters can be accessed once Second Step is complete by pressing 'Tab' in the build menu

notes.title: Minor bugfix and typographical fixes
notes.content:
Fixed digging to allow to dig south with 'K' key
Some typos were fixed

notes.title: Minor feature
notes.content: Added ability to sort inventory by pressing 'S'

notes.title: Minor QoL Improvement
notes.content:
Added the ability to pick up, harvest and forage by holding the 'E' key down.
Added 'G' as an alternative key for pick up, harvest and forage actions
